text.p: The stock exchange said on Thursday that trade in Brasa furniture will be suspended from next Monday.
"Brasa will be temporarily suspended from next Monday as its own capital is currently negative," Guntars Kokarevich, the bourse's finance department manager, told Reuters.
"The company will return to the secondary list when it has tackled its financial problems," Kokarevichs said.
"Brasa could then also be included in the bourse's third list if it gets formed," he added.
The bourse earlier said its board had approved the idea of forming a third list for less liquid stocks in addition to the present official and secondary lists.
The securities commission is currently reviewing the documentation behind the third list before deciding on giving its approval.
